metadata.title: Surreal Vertical Garden with Solitary Flamingo

recipe.visualDefinition: A towering, dark grey stone wall covered in dense, tiered clusters of pink and magenta vegetation, featuring a single, dark-bodied flamingo with bright pink legs standing at the base.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the massive floral wall and the small solitary bird
Color contrast between the dark, desaturated stone and the vibrant pink flora
Texture contrast between the jagged, wet rock face and the soft, feathery plants
coreInvariants: Monochromatic pink-to-magenta palette for all vegetation
Dark, charcoal-grey stone background with vertical water streaks
A single flamingo as the focal point at the bottom center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The flamingo is positioned at the bottom center, appearing very small relative to the massive vertical garden above it.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The flamingo's bright pink legs provide a sharp anchor point against the dark ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the flamingo, travels up the vertical streaks of the wall, and explores the horizontal tiers of pink foliage.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, exposed stone between plant clusters acts as negative space, providing breathing room for the dense textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and slate grey for the stone wall and ground.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Various shades of pink, magenta, and dusty rose for the vegetation.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright neon pink for the flamingo's legs.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the pinks against a low-saturation, low-value dark background.
paletteRestrictions: No greens or blues in the vegetation

graphicDevices: Vertical water/mineral streaks on the stone

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a massive, dark grey vertical rock wall with wet streaks. Populate the wall with horizontal tiers of dense, fluffy pink and magenta plants, ferns, and flowers. Ensure the ground is dark and scattered with pink petals.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a single, dark-grey flamingo with vibrant pink legs standing in the bottom center foreground, looking slightly to the side.

verificationChecks: Is the vegetation strictly in the pink/magenta spectrum?
Is the flamingo small enough to convey a sense of scale?
Are there visible vertical streaks on the dark stone wall?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the water streaks on the wall
Specific shade of pink (from pastel to neon)
mustRedesign: Bright blue skies or daylight lighting

mustAchieve: Clear separation between the dark wall and pink plants
avoid: Clashing colors like bright yellow or green

postGenerationChecks: Check that the flamingo's legs are the brightest pink in the image.
Ensure the stone wall has a wet, matte appearance.
Verify the plants look like they are growing out of the rock face in tiers.
Confirm the absence of any blue or green hues.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dark, textured vertical surface with monochromatic, high-contrast organic clusters and a single, small focal point at the base to create a sense of scale and surrealism.
